caption: Afterlight is an independent original motion artwork: sixteen metallic bands shaped by a moving light.
Play the twenty-second film. Camera, geometry and lighting change continuously through five movements.
Orbit brings the camera close to the sculpture, revealing the bright edges and fine surfaces of its bands.
Release opens the orbit into a fan of tilted bands. This is imagined geometry, not filmed astronomy.
The form settles in Afterlight. Download the complete film, poster, descriptions or reproducible source.
